manufacturing_acceptance.reason: Repository-rule geometry and numerical screening do not qualify the process, compact models, interconnect, or IO protection. Request-supplied limits and declarations cannot clear this policy.

sources.evidence_class: independent design notes, not a foundry specification
accepted_context: Non-self-aligned design L must agree with the dopant-gap channel length after mask conversion; TiN grows by 2 um on each side
Legacy Bridge resistor and optional body-terminal extraction can be incomplete despite displayed PCell values
VIA1/ML2 availability after 2025 depends on the specific fab
not_transferred: Ordinary-device FD claims do not determine either polarity's measured depletion mode
Changing schematic L to a seven-digit protrusion formula is not a substitute for correct extraction or a calibrated physical Leff
An observed permissive DRC spacing is not permission to relax the documented final-mask gate-to-contact distance

sources.evidence_class: conference proceedings on process/tool methodology, pp.190-195
accepted_context: Section III.B, pp.192-193 explicitly requires ML1 to cover TiN across the SOI step to avoid gate-material breakage
The discussed SOI example disables upper-metal VIA because only ML1 is available there
The PTS06 0.6 um example needed a fab-approved vendor final check because reused DRC omitted process-specific wide-metal rules
not_transferred: The paper specifies no numerical SOI-step strap margin; the repository 2 um minimum remains experimental
PTS06 bulk-CMOS signoff and thermal-shutdown examples do not qualify Minimal Fab rules or thermal parameters

accepted_context: The demonstrator used about 100 nm final silicon, 400 nm BOX, 6 nm gate oxide, 50 nm TiN, 300 nm Al and 300 nm P-TEOS, with two Al layers
Its core used L4/W28 PMOS and L4/W14 NMOS; IO used L4/W32 for both polarities; 1338 transistors and 80 by 80 um pads were reported
Process monitors included polarity-resolved IV, a via chain, TiN open checks, NAND and half-adder circuits at wafer corners
The 40 ohm measurement is a chain of 4 by 4 um vias, not a per-via resistance
The packaged shift-register SHMOO reported 357 kHz at 3 V and 204 kHz at 1.5 V using its stated test-rate definition
ESD-equipped IO was drawn, but ESD ratings were not supplied; TID/SEE tests, variability and lot-definition quality assurance remained open
not_transferred: The 6 nm-oxide, L4 demonstrator cannot calibrate the present 15 nm-oxide, W24/L6 model or its PVT and fMAX
Historical two-metal demonstration does not supply revision-specific ML2/VIA1 RC or universal fab availability
An ESD circuit drawing and SOI radiation rationale are not measured ESD or radiation qualification

retained_primary_document_conflicts: PDK_minimalFabSOICMOS.pdf p.18 labels N/P diffusion resistor sheet values 200/400 ohm per square, while the measured p.8 table gives 180/1200; extraction retains the measured p.8 values

PDK_minimalFabSOICMOS.pdf p.18 specifies 300 nm TEOS for TiN-Al capacitors but no measured 0.115 fF/um2 density; that legacy value is analytically consistent with ideal 300 nm SiO2, not a qualified coupling rule
The historical 300 nm TEOS drawings do not resolve the separate 2021 cross-section's 250 nm value for the present process revision

missing_prerequisites: Measured metal-to-substrate, inter-metal coupling and fringe capacitance, with a validated extraction rule set
Independent MOS diffusion/access/contact resistance calibration separating the fitted RDSW contribution
Contact-size scaling characterization beyond the measured 5 by 5 um openings
Qualified upper-metal and via RC before any multimetal post-layout analysis

evidence.scope: Measured sheet/contact terms, explicit extraction ownership, and missing RC terms
Current-driven linear R/RC screening; no nonlinear MOS droop feedback

missing_prerequisites: Polarity-resolved NMOS and PMOS body/back-gate bias and C-V measurements; depletion modes remain independently undecided
A validated physical substrate/back-gate connection and allowed-bias specification; a GLOBAL SUB declaration is not physical proof
Physically supported body-contact mapping and extraction beyond the diagnostic NMOS4 LVS path

evidence.scope: Independent NMOS/PMOS depletion uncertainty and four-terminal common-E contract
Diagnostic NMOS4 mapping, unsupported PMOS body ties

documented_absolute_maximum.scope: Absolute-magnitude violation screen only. A value inside this envelope does not establish reverse-bias allowance, pulse duration, temperature applicability, E/back-gate limits, ESD immunity or a safe operating area.

missing_prerequisites: Revision- and polarity-specific terminal, oxide and back-gate limits with duration, duty-cycle and temperature applicability
Validated power-up, power-down, input-overdrive and pad-overshoot operating requirements; 3 V bench conditions are not absolute ratings

evidence.scope: Actual mapped terminal waveforms can be screened against explicitly sourced limits, not process qualification
Experimental model operating scope is limited to the stated engine, geometry, 3 V and 25 C

missing_prerequisites: Measured and validated process, voltage, temperature and geometry-dependent compact-model corners
Qualified dynamic charge and interconnect RC over those corners
Validated timing, slew and load coverage with design-specific timing constraints before any signoff Liberty use

evidence.scope: Stage-1 nominal remains a research baseline; experimental bridge cards are version- and geometry-scoped
Experimental nominal corner only; SPEF, MCSTA and OpenROAD IR reports disabled

missing_prerequisites: Revision-specific metal/via cross-sections, thickness and effective current-carrying geometry
Qualified DC, peak, RMS, temperature and duty-cycle current-density limits
A calibrated lifetime/acceleration model and mission profile

evidence.scope: Reports branch current and I-squared-R hotspots; no qualified current density or lifetime is inferred

missing_prerequisites: Measured die, BOX, package and boundary-condition thermal parameters and junction-temperature calibration
A validated temperature-coupled electrical model and coupled circuit reruns for delay and leakage
Device and interconnect power ownership that prevents counting supply power and local dissipation twice

evidence.scope: First-order Rth/Cth sensitivity with fixed measured currents, not a calibrated junction-temperature or coupled-SPICE result

missing_prerequisites: Manufacturing-sequence-specific exposed conductor/gate area and perimeter rules, including TiN, diffusion and metal processing
Qualified gate-oxide antenna limits and a characterized discharge/repair device or approved routing repair

evidence.scope: Geometry and SOI-edge checks do not implement a process-qualified antenna rule
Automatic antenna repair is disabled rather than assuming a qualified diode

missing_prerequisites: Qualified pad-opening enclosure, die-edge/seal-ring, bonding and probing specifications
Pad and rail current limits with applicable pulse duration and temperature
Verified pad-to-rail and rail-to-return discharge topology and measured HBM/CDM/TLP performance
Qualified EOS operating and fault envelopes; ESD declarations alone do not establish protection

evidence.scope: PAD/ML1 geometry and explicit mapping are structural checks; manufacturing acceptance remains blocked
